inputs.mid_filings_read: NHTSA MID Part 565 files: Toyota 159 filings MY1984-2011 downloaded (text-searched where OCR text exists; MY1991, 2000, 2003, 2004, 2005 tables read), Nissan 104 filings MY1985-2013 downloaded (scans; MY1985, 1990, 1998, 2001, 2002, 2013 charts read), plus MY2025 Nissan (ORG23829). Downloaded 2026-11-05 from vpic.nhtsa.dot.gov/mid (search API + displayfile).

answer.toyota: The VIN does NOT encode the transmission in any model year read (MY1991, 2000, 2003, 2004, 2005 filings; same layout for Toyota-built Lexus and Scion). Positions 4-8 carry engine, line, model/series, grade or restraint, body/cab and drive. Manual-only cells reachable by the engine character or pre-2000 grade digit: MR2 Turbo (JT2SW22, MY1991-95), Corolla XRS (2T1BY..E, MY2005-06), Matrix XRS (2T1KY..E, MY2004-06). Candidates only: Celica All-Trac Turbo (JT2ST88, MY1990-93), Tacoma 2.7 4x4 (P/U + X, MY2005-10), T100 2.7 4x2 (MY1994).
answer.lexus: The VIN does NOT encode the transmission (Lexus shares Toyota's filings: MY1991 LS400/ES250, MY2004 RX330, MY2005 RX330). No Lexus engine was sold manual-only, so no rule.
answer.scion: The VIN does NOT encode the transmission for Toyota-built Scions (xA, xB, tC, xD, iQ, iM; MY2004 filing). Scion FR-S (WMI JF1) is Subaru-built and IS ruled by Subaru's character 11 in vin_rules_1; Scion iA (WMI 3MY) is Mazda-built (no transmission character). No manual-only Scion engine, so no rule here.
answer.nissan: The VIN does NOT encode the transmission in any model year read (MY1985, 1990, 1998, 2001, 2002, 2013, 2025). Position 4 is the engine and position 8 the restraint system (cars) or GVWR/brake/drive (trucks: S/T/X 2WD, Y 4WD). Manual-only cells reachable by engine + drive: Xterra 2.4L (5N1DD28, MY2000-04), Frontier 2.4L 4WD (1N6DD..Y, MY1998-2000). Candidate only: 720/D21 pickup 2.4L 4WD (MY1984-97).
answer.infiniti: The VIN does NOT encode the transmission (Infiniti is in Nissan's charts: MY1990, 2002, 2013, 2025). No Infiniti engine was sold manual-only (EPA lists an automatic for every Infiniti engine/drive cell), so no rule.
answer.vpic_already_decodes_it: vPIC leaves TransmissionStyle blank for these VIN patterns, so every in-scope car without a listing transmission is a newly confirmed car. The flip side: ground truth for these makes is almost entirely automatics from listings or vPIC defaults, and no in-scope car has a checkable label, so every kept rule is low_sample and rests on the manufacturer's code table + EPA + an independent reference.

vin_scheme.toyota_pre_2000_passenger_car: VDS (VIN 4-8): 4 engine type, 5 line, 6 model designation, 7 series (grade), 8 body type + restraint (MY1991 filing). MR2: VIN 7 = 2 means 3S-GTE turbo, 1 = 5S-FE. Celica: VIN 7 = 8 'turbo All-Trac', 5 GT-S, 6 ST, 7 GT.
vin_scheme.toyota_pre_2000_truck: VIN 4 engine (R 22R-E, V 3VZ-E), 5 line (N truck), 6 drive train (8/9 4x2, 0/1 4x4), 7 cab/chassis, 8 series + brake / GVWR (MY1991 filing).
vin_scheme.toyota_2000_on_passenger_car: VIN 4 body type (+2WD/4WD), 5 engine type, 6 series (chassis code), 7 restraint system, 8 line (MY2000-2005 filings). Corolla/Matrix 5th digit: R = 1ZZ-FE, Y = 2ZZ-GE.
vin_scheme.toyota_2005_tacoma: VIN 4 cab + drive + brake (N/T/J/K 2WD, P/U/L/M 4WD), 5 engine (X 2TR-FE 2.7L, U 1GR-FE 4.0L), 6 series, 7 grade, 8 line N.
vin_scheme.nissan_cars: VIN 4 engine, 5 line, 6 model change, 7 body type, 8 restraint system (+ 2WD/4WD from the 2010s) (MY1985, 1990, 2002, 2013, 2025 filings).
vin_scheme.nissan_trucks_mpv: VIN 4 engine, 5 line, 6 model change, 7 body/cab, 8 GVWR class + chassis/brake system + drive: S/T/X = 2WD, Y = standard 4WD (MY1998, 2001, 2002 charts).
vin_scheme.transmission_character: none, in any filing read for these five makes

not_encoded_or_not_ruled: Toyota/Lexus/Scion and Nissan/Infiniti VINs carry no transmission character, so for the large majority of these cars (Camry, Corolla 1ZZ/2ZR, Tacoma 2WD and V6, Sentra, Altima, Versa, Frontier/Xterra V6, 350Z/370Z, G35/G37, IS/SC ...) the VIN cannot say manual vs automatic. Those cars need listing text, a build-sheet source, or the owner.

Nissan Sentra SE-R Spec V (MY2002-06 and MY2007-12, 6-speed manual only) shares its engine code with the SE-R (manual/automatic MY2002-06, CVT MY2007-12); position 8 is the restraint system (A/D), so the Spec V is not identifiable from the VIN. Not ruled.
Nissan 370Z MY2021 (EPA lists only Manual 6-spd) and 370Z NISMO: engine code shared with automatic cars in other years; not ruled.

Toyota MR2 Spyder (MY2000-05): EPA lists only manuals, but the SMT sequential gearbox (an automated manual, which the app does not call manual) was sold from MY2002 and the VIN does not tell it apart. Not ruled.

Toyota Celica All-Trac Turbo ST165 (MY1988-89), Camry All-Trac 2.0 4WD (MY1988 manual-only per EPA), 4Runner 2.4 4WD (MY1984, 1994-95), 22R-TE turbo pickups (MY1985-88), FJ60 Land Cruiser (MY1984-87), GR Corolla (MY2023+), Nissan Pathfinder 2.4 4WD (MY1987-89), 200SX turbo (MY1986), Sentra 4WD wagon (MY1987-88), Stanza 4WD wagon (MY1987), Sentra 1.7 diesel (MY1985-86): EPA lists only manuals, but the filings for those years were not read; no lot car with a matching VIN was found for most of them. Not ruled.
Matrix XRS MY2003 (2T1KY..E): EPA lists both a 4-speed automatic and a 6-speed manual for the 2ZZ-GE that year (Wikipedia agrees), so MY2003 is excluded from the Matrix rule.
Lexus and Infiniti: no engine/drive cell is manual-only in EPA for any year; no rule.
Cars without a 17-character VIN (summary.five_make_coverage.<make>.no_vin) cannot be reached by VIN rules.
Cars at Canadian yards (AB, BC) are scanned but not newly confirmed: the manual-only facts are US-market facts (EPA).

ground_truth_precision_manual_claims_kep.note: no in-scope car has a checkable ground-truth label

validation_method: For each rule, every lot car is matched by WMI, valid check digit, VIN model year (character 10, listing year picks the 30-year cycle) and the fixed + coded characters. 'checkable' = its ground_truth.jsonl line has class manual/automatic/cvt/amt/dct and uniformCell is empty (uniform-cell lines are vPIC model-level defaults, counted separately). Agreement = same manual-vs-not-manual answer. epa_cell = the EPA rows the claim rests on, re-read per model year: 'manual_only_years' must cover the rule's years. vpic_check = live vPIC decode of each in-scope VIN (vin_rules_2_vpic.json): engine model / displacement / drive must match the code's meaning. Status: candidate when flagged (evidence short of certain); drop when >= 20 checkable and agreement < 99.5%; low_sample when < 20 checkable (kept: the code table is the manufacturer's own Part 565 filing or vPIC built from it, and the manual-only fact has EPA plus an independent reference); keep otherwise. 'newly_confirmed_manual' = in-scope cars at US yards whose published extras transmission is empty today.

citations.doc: NHTSA 01-22-N11B-3801, Toyota Motor Corporate Services of North America letter 1990-07-27, 'Toyota and Lexus VIN Coding System applicable to 1991 models' (19 pp.)
citations.says: Passenger-car VDS: 1st digit (VIN 4) engine type, 2nd (VIN 5) line, 3rd (VIN 6) model designation, 4th (VIN 7) series (grade), 5th (VIN 8) body type & restraint system. MR2: engine S (3S-GTE / 5S-FE), line W, model 2 (SW20L, SW21L), body M/N; Note #4: 'As for MR2, engine types are identified as follows: 3S-GTE = VDS 1st digit S, 4th digit 2; 5S-FE = S, 1'. Celica: line T, model 8 (AT180L, ST184L, ST185L), grade 5 GT-S / 6 ST / 7 GT / 8 'turbo All-Trac', body F 2DR CP 2WD, N 3DR LB 2WD, P 3DR LB 4WD; Note #3: '3S-GTE = S, 8; 5S-FE = S, 5 or 7'. Truck VDS: engine (R 22R-E, V 3VZ-E), line N, drive train type (8/9 = 4x2, 0/1 = 4x4), cab type & chassis, series & brake systems / GVWR. MPV (4Runner, Land Cruiser, Previa) and Lexus LS400/ES250: same layout. No position carries the transmission.

Truck chart: position 4 2.4L gasoline = D; position 5 Nissan Frontier Truck = D; position 7 Regular Cab 1, King Cab 6; position 8 GVWR / chassis-brake: Class C Rear ABS (2WD) S, 4-Wheel ABS (2WD) T, Class D Standard (4WD) Y. No transmission character.

citations.doc: NHTSA 01-022-N11B-8061, Nissan North America letter 2000-11-28, MY2002 Nissan VIN coding system (passenger car; MPV and truck)
citations.says: MPV/truck chart: Xterra position 4 engine 2.4L gasoline = D, 3.3L gasoline = E; position 5 Xterra = D; position 7 4-door wagon = 8; position 8 Class C 4-wheel ABS (2WD) S, Class D Standard (4WD) Y. Frontier: 2.4L D, 3.3L E, 3.3L supercharged M; line D; Regular Cab 1, King Cab 6, Crew Cab 7; position 8 Class C rear ABS (2WD) S / 4-wheel ABS (2WD) T, Class D Standard (4WD) Y. Passenger-car chart: position 8 = restraint system. No transmission character.

conditions: VIN is 17 characters with a valid check digit (character 9); VINs that fail it are skipped
model year from VIN character 10; the listing year only picks the 30-year cycle and must be within 2 years
fixed characters: char4 in [NS], char5 in [D]
car is at a US yard (Canadian-market offerings are not covered by the EPA evidence)

citations.doc: Search for an independent statement on 1985-97 Nissan pickup 4-cylinder 4x4 transmissions, 2026-11-05
citations.says: No manufacturer or review source found. One owner comment (CarGurus) says the 1997 4-cylinder 4x4 came only with a 5-speed; content-farm buying guides say the automatic was offered 'with both engines'. EPA alone supports manual-only, so the rule stays a candidate.

citations.doc: EPA fueleconomy.gov vehicles.csv (downloaded 2026-11-05, Last-Modified 2026-09-29)

rules.candidate_reason: Manual-only rests on EPA alone (every year 1984-1997 lists only Manual 5-spd for the 2.4 4WD truck, while the V6 4WD lists an automatic). No manufacturer or review statement found; weak web sources say an automatic was offered 'with both engines'. The truck charts for MY1984-1997 were not read (MY1998 letter confirms the 2.4L code was S before 1998).
rules.evidence_gaps: Truck charts for MY1984-1997 not read; code meanings from vPIC and the MY1998 revision letter.
